title: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
Jurisdiction: India (eligible central government groups/cities)
Category: Government employee and pensioner healthcare
Type: Insurance / Health Assurance
Details: Healthcare scheme providing eligible beneficiaries access to wellness centres and empanelled providers under CGHS rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Central Government employees, eligible pensioners and other notified categories, subject to current rules and city/service conditions.
Individual Enrolment Required: True

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Proof of eligible employment or pension status, identity details, family/dependent details and documents specified in current application process.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Apply through official CGHS online services or designated CGHS wellness centre/office, as applicable.
Official Portal: https://cghs.mohfw.gov.in/
